features.text: STATIC-DYNAMIC STRETCH SYSTEM: Combines constant and adaptive stretching to treat mild to severe elbow contractures.
THREE-POINT STRAP DESIGN: Delivers targeted, anti-spasticity support to promote muscle inhibition and flexibility.
FLEXIBLE UPRIGHTS: React naturally to muscle tone changes while maintaining steady therapeutic force.
SOFT, SECURE CUFFS: Distribute pressure evenly to prevent discomfort during therapy.
PROGRESSIVE THERAPY DESIGN: Encourages gradual recovery through low-load prolonged stretching.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Mild to severe elbow flexion or extension contractures
Spasticity and abnormal muscle tone from neurological disorders
Joint stiffness or adaptive tissue shortening of the elbow
Limited range of motion requiring static-dynamic stretching
Progressive therapy for restoring functional elbow mobility
